text:
Aisha: Heads up — 10:00am all-hands today. Small agenda tweak and the stream was flaky in rehearsal :grimacing:. If you're presenting, please join the presenters Zoom 5m early. I'll pin the updated agenda in the calendar.
Ben: Thanks — what's the agenda tweak?
Aisha: Swap infra updates and roadmap demo (infra first, demo after Q&A).
Carlos: FYI the stream dropped for me yesterday during infra. Who's monitoring recording this time? @Mike?
Mike: I can monitor. If Zoom recording fails I'll start a local backup and upload to S3. My local script: `./tools/record-backup.sh --session all-hands`
Elena: Should we have a hot fallback (Loom or OBS RTMP)? I can spin up a Loom link in 2m.
Mike: Good call — Loom as fallback sounds safe. I'll keep a Loom/OBS ready.
Ben: Do we need to update the calendar invite for the swap?
Aisha: Already edited the agenda block in the invite and added a short note about the swap. Link: https://cal.company.com/all-hands
Sre-Bot: [automated] Monitoring hook attached to meeting_id 7f3a9b - analytics online.
Carlos: Cool. Also please ask presenters to upload a PDF of slides to the thread beforehand to avoid deck issues. Last time some slides didn't render.
Mike: Noted. If recording fails I'll run: `ffmpeg -f x11grab -i :0 -t 00:45:00 output.mp4` (local) and then `aws s3 cp output.mp4 s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1714501234.mp4`.
Dev-Bot: Zoom recording started (meeting 7f3a9b)
Sre-Bot: [alert] Recording segment error detected at 1714501302 - dropped 00:02:10.
Mike: Saw the error. Local backup is clean; starting upload now. ETA ~12m.
Elena: I'll draft a short Loom capture of the infra demo as a fallback and post link if upload stalls.
Ben: Will presenters still be able to screen-share? Last time some people couldn't.
Aisha: Yes — presenters should join the presenters Zoom (different link from main room). I'll DM everyone presenting with the presenters Zoom link and a checklist (mic, camera, share settings).
Carlos: Can we pin the PDF slides in the thread and also put them in the #all-hands-summary channel after?
Aisha: Yes — we'll pin in this thread during the meeting and @Elena can post the condensed notes to #all-hands-summary.
Mike: Upload complete: s3://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1714501234.mp4 (private). Setting group read perms now.
Dev-Bot: Upload succeeded for object 1714501234.mp4.
Aisha: Thanks — if anyone runs into playback issues after the meeting ping me. Will record action items and pin recording when everything's live. See you in ~10. :raised_hands:
